Context: 9. Overtime, Alfowance

of official transport to attend the field work. Such officers are supposed to report in office before proceeding to field. In cases, where officials are required to attend the field work directly from home, they may be extended facility of official transport from home in lieu of Transport Allowance and OTA may be given on the basis of the log book of that vehicle, duly verified by their senior officers.  
- Resoln. No. 11-1/2016-IC, dated 6-7-2017, OMs, dated 19-6-2018 and 8-7-2020.
